rationale: Independent reading: held EO 11492 (34 FR 17721, Oct. 30, 1969) is a single sentence substituting sec. 3(a) of EO 11398 (Citizens Advisory Committee on Physical Fitness and Sports); no own term or savings clause. Held EO 11562 (35 FR 15063, Sept. 25, 1970) sec. 7: 'Executive Order No. 11398 of March 4, 1968, and Executive Order No. 11492 of October 30, 1969, are hereby revoked.' Sec. 8 (Construction) only protects functions vested by law, it does not save EO 11492. Both the amending order and its base are revoked by number: my independent status NO, agreeing with the producer. Refutation attempts: quoted section verified at the held text; whole-order revocation, not an amendment; no earlier own-term end. D6: was any later event that ended or changed this clause removed or ignored? No. Held texts naming 11492 are only EO 11492 and EO 11562; held texts naming 11398 (EO 11398, 11492, 11562 and incidental hits) show no other substitution of sec. 3(a) before 1970; EO 12345 later revokes EO 11562 'as amended' without restoring EO 11398 or 11492. Accept as a provisional NO hypothesis (end Sept. 25, 1970).
